evals.prompt: Review the pending upstream sync PR without pushing.
evals.expected_output: Reads the recorded pin and full diff, checks pristine source and generated output, reports runtime gaps, and makes no external mutation.

evals.prompt: Integrate an upstream change that renames a skill and changes a Cursor dispatch field.
evals.expected_output: Uses a source worktree, keeps raw source identical to the incoming SHA, edits only adapters, regenerates to remove the old skill, verifies installation, and prepares a PR without merging.
Uses the consumer update path rather than cloning or maintaining the upstream fork.

evals.prompt: The merge conflicts and Codex cannot execute the changed workflow.
evals.expected_output: Inspects merge intent, preserves unrelated work, stops on unresolved intent, and names actual runtime validation as unverified.
